summary_en: Open-market self-tender offer completed 1 Jun 2026 after 20 business days (30 Apr – 1 Jun 2026). Purchase price ¥1,986/share. Settlement 23 Jun 2026 via Nomura Securities. Share count and total yen not disclosed in results summary.
title_en: Notice regarding results of open-market purchase of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 28 April 2026, Aisin Corporation's board of directors resolved to conduct an open-market self-tender offer (公開買付け) for treasury shares within the limits and period previously authorized by the board under Company Law Article 156(1) and the company's articles of incorporation. The offer was conducted from 30 April 2026 (Thursday) through 1 June 2026 (Monday), comprising 20 business days. The purchase price per ordinary share was set at ¥1,986. Settlement is scheduled to commence on 23 June 2026 through Nomura Securities. The specific number of shares acquired and total purchase amount are not detailed in the results announcement provided. Tendering shareholders will receive proceeds net of applicable withholding tax; tax treatment varies depending on residency status and shareholding size.
